halide color photographic sensitive material", "abstract": "PURPOSE:To enable rapid desilvering as well as to maintain the activity of a processing soln. and to ensure uniform finish by incorporating a specified compd. into a color photographic sensitive material and specifying the amt. of a tank soln. circulated per 1min in a processing bath having bleaching capacity. CONSTITUTION:A compd. which reacts with the oxidized product of an arom. prim. amine color developing agent and releases a bleaching accelerator is incorporated into a color photographic sensitive material, and the amt. of a tank soln. circulated per 1min in a processing bath having bleaching capacity is regulated to >=1/10 of the volume of a tank contg. the bath. The new problem that a bleaching accelerating effect weakens by well circulating and stirring a processing soln. having bleaching capacity is solved by incorporating the bleaching accelerator releasing compd. into the sensitive material. Since the temp. of the processing soln. of the processing bath having bleaching capacity is satisfactorily regulated by circulation, the activity of the processing soln. is maintained, uniform finish is ensured and rapid desilvering is enabled.", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "51d9d7b96f90627c39b13eef74f0184ea5a7d04f14bf2a2c9f0cce2cf4501d2f", "title_text_id": "43d6efcf790d63f680ec4d0f919569abf3abf72626eb88f216b4c13c881484d5", "abstract_text_id": "d6662dfd78f93054e905d8a9fe01532fd0095f4e91958cbcd20649d19a73c4cf", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "1987-07-08", "selection_role": "random", "center_cosine": 0.8884323835372925, "abstract_truncated": false}, {"row_idx": 2878, "family_id": "google:11662815", "pub_id": "unresolved:ee22f37c74fd072f5ca1b32e", "publication_id": "JP-H03211548-A", "title": "Processing method for silver halide color photographic sensitive material", "abstract": "PURPOSE:To stabilize photographic characteristics by processing a silver halide color photographic sensitive material contg. a yellow coupler represented by a specified formula in the blue-sensitive layer with a specified color developing soln. CONSTITUTION:A silver halide color photographic sensitive material contg. a silver chloride-rich silver halide emulsion having >=90mol% silver chloride content and a yellow coupler represented by formula I in the blue-sensitive layer is processed with a color developing soln. contg. 3X10<-2>-1.5X10<-1>mol/l chlorine ions. In the formula I, R1 is aryl or tert. alkyl, R2 is F, alkyl, aryl, etc., R3 is a group substitutable on the benzene ring, X is H or a group releasable by a coupling reaction with the oxidized body of an arom. prim. amine developing agent and l is an integer of 0-4. A photographic characteristic stabilizing effect can be produced.", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "090a3d98701049b731d8586e07d23861826adb268259b13f55dd1a7c954f5239", "title_text_id": "5174decf6afe65f94c8e970e4367f206f2ec2e4027ca346fb65da8ce2de78211", "abstract_text_id": "30c99ef93c9b95b1206e71578cb990663e0017eba3d8a8fa11bc6e146ea4b5d4", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "1990-01-17", "selection_role": "random", "center_cosine": 0.8997930884361267, "abstract_truncated": false}, {"row_idx": 77376, "family_id": "google:17578120", "pub_id": "unresolved:062c82ad99dbcea0ae071e9e", "publication_id": "JP-H07128828-A", "title": "Processing method of silver halide color photographic material", "abstract": "PURPOSE:To prevent deterioration of adhesion propery and contamination of a photosensitive material after continuous processing by incorporating an org. acid iron (III) complex salt and dicarboxylic acid compd. into the processing liquid and incorporating a water-soluble cellulose deriv. into a stabilizing liquid. CONSTITUTION:In the process including color developing, desilverizing and processing with a stabilizer, the processing liquid having bleaching performance used in the desilverizing process contains at least one kind of org. acid iron (III) complex salt and at least one kind of dicarboxylic acid compd. The stabilizer contains at least one kind of water-soluble cellulose deriv. In this case, the processing liquid having bleaching performance means a processing liquid containing a bleaching agent used for the desilverizing process. For example, it means a bleaching liquid or a bleaching and fixing liquid.
